messages.text: Constitution Hill tastes Flat defeat as Pride Of Arras scores at Kempton

metadata.summary: Constitution Hill had to settle for an ultimately well-beaten fourth to Pride Of Arras on his eagerly-awaited third Flat outing in the William Hill September Stakes at Kempton Park.
metadata.content: Kempton: Constitution Hill tastes Flat defeat as Pride Of Arras takes September Stakes | Racing News | Sky Sports Skip to content Kempton: Constitution Hill tastes Flat defeat as Pride Of Arras takes September Stakes Former champion hurdler Constitution Hill tasted defeat for the first time on the Flat when only managing fourth in the September Stakes at Kempton; The race was won by 2025 Dante Stakes winner Pride Of Arras, who defeated odds-on favourite Gethin. Saturday 5 September 2026 16:12, UK Image: Constitution Hill finished fourth at Kempton Constitution Hill had to settle for an ultimately well-beaten fourth to Pride Of Arras on his eagerly-awaited third Flat outing in the William Hill September Stakes at Kempton Park. So brilliant at his peak in his hurdling days, Nicky Henderson's superstar has remained one of racing's biggest draws since switching to the level - but this Group Three affair was a major step up from his victories at Southwell and at this track in February and March respectively. As the odds-on Gethin took early command of the mile-and-a-half contest, Billy Loughnane and Constitution Hill (9-2) sat in a close-up fourth and were still travelling with a degree of menace turning for home. messages.text: Russell tops Hamilton at Monza ahead of qualifying

metadata.summary: George Russell established himself as pole position favourite ahead of Italian Grand Prix qualifying as the Mercedes driver topped Ferrari's Lewis Hamilton in final practice.
metadata.content: Italian GP: George Russell tops Lewis Hamilton in final practice as Mercedes appear to establish edge over Ferrari | F1 News | Sky Sports Skip to content Italian GP: George Russell tops Lewis Hamilton in final practice as Mercedes appear to establish edge over Ferrari George Russell tops Lewis Hamilton in final practice at Monza; Mercedes appear to have edge over Ferrari going into qualifying; watch Italian Grand Prix Qualifying later on Saturday at 3pm, with build-up from 2.15pm, live on Sky Sports F1 and Main Event Saturday 5 September 2026 14:08, UK Please use Chrome browser for a more accessible video player Lewis Hamilton and Max Verstappen fought a wheel-to-wheel battle for during P3 of the Italian Grand Prix at Monza George Russell established himself as pole position favourite ahead of Italian Grand Prix qualifying as the Mercedes driver topped Ferrari's Lewis Hamilton in final practice. Mercedes and Ferrari had appeared closely matched in Friday's two practice sessions, and once more led the way on Saturday as Russell's time of 1:22.219s put him just over two tenths of a second clear of Hamilton at Monza. Russell is shouldering Mercedes' hopes of claiming pole, with his team-mate Kimi Antonelli, the championship leader, serving penalties for taking new engine parts that will leave him starting from the back of the grid regardless of where he qualifies.
